content: Art 9(1) Directive 2023/970 lists (a) gender pay gap; (b) gap in complementary or variable components; (c) median gender pay gap; (d) median gap in complementary/variable; (e) proportion of female and male workers receiving complementary/variable components; (f) proportion of female and male workers in each quartile pay band; (g) gap by categories of workers broken down by ordinary basic wage and complementary/variable. Art 9(2)-(4) set the 250+/150-249/100-149 phase-in on previous calendar year data; 9(6) requires management to confirm accuracy after consulting workers reps; 9(7) sends (a)-(g) to the national authority while only (a)-(f) may be self-published. Art 10(1) requires joint pay assessment where (a) >=5% average pay difference in any category, (b) not justified on objective gender-neutral criteria, (c) not remedied within six months of submission. Art 3(1) defines gender pay gap with the MALE average as denominator, median gap with the male median as denominator, and quartile pay band as four EQUAL GROUPS of workers by pay level. No small-group suppression threshold appears in the Directive; the six-person rule is German EntgTranspG s12.
